findings.trigger: At 2026-10-08, accepted exact-need suitable supply of 5 MW is effective only until 2026-10-09, while the accepted activity start window is 2027-01-01 to 2027-02-01 with 31-day duration.
findings.evidence: current_accepted_facts and SQL preload include fact versions active at the current instant only. qualification_from_facts uses the suitable-supply MW/quality to subtract from demand without comparing its effective interval to the required future start window and duration. A pure domain repro selected all five current accepted facts and returned Lead with a derived positive gap even though the suitable-supply version expires months before the activity. The accepted fact values, dates and current-time selection were explicit in the saved repro; no DB or provider call was made.
findings.impact: The Lead calculation treats supply that is unsupported for the need's activity interval as suitable available supply. This violates PRD requirements 21, 23 and 24 and the A6 packet's interval-specific suitable-supply gate. A similar expiry mismatch can affect other fact kinds; correction must validate compatible effective coverage rather than simply ignore expiry.
findings.required_correction: Bind the accepted timing and supply facts to one compatible activity interval and require supported suitable-supply capacity/quality throughout that interval before deriving a Lead gap. Preserve current-time expiry, source contradiction, version history and bounded preload semantics. Add a future-window-versus-expiring-supply regression and valid covering-interval positive case.
